race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
race.verdict: Runner-up in a Grade 2 novice hurdle at Cheltenham last year, SIXANDAHALF couldn't make the most of a good opportunity sent chasing at Sligo on her return, but with that outing behind her she is fancied to do much better this time round. The biggest threat could come from Miss Fourie , who looked set to win last time before nearly unseating late on. SIXANDAHALF (IRE) MISS FOURIE (IRE) MO GHILLE MAR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sixandahalf (8/15), Miss Fourie (2/1), Mo Ghille Mar (10/1), Cruisin Susan (66/1)
